data = json.loads(data_str)

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
periods = list(range(1, data["periods"] + 1))
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]
moq = data["constraints"]["moq"]

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t]
z = {}  # z[p,t] binary
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r]
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r]
W = {}  # W[p,l,t]
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t]

# Create variables
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        # Order quantity and binary activation variable
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        z[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"z_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            # Lost sales variable
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Waste variable
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Inventory and sales variables for each remaining shelf life
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Constraints
# 1. MOQ constraints
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1] * z[p, t], name=f"moq_upper_{p}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] >= moq * z[p, t], name=f"moq_lower_{p}_{t}")

# 2. Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# 3. Fresh inventory inflow constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 4. Inventory aging (FIFO) constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods[:-1]:  # t from 1 to T-1
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1],
                           name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 5. Waste calculation constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1],
                       name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 6. Sales constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            # Sales cannot exceed inventory
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r],
                           name=f"sales_limit_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Total sales + lost sales = demand
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l],
                       name=f"demand_satisfaction_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 7. Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in periods
)

inventory_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in periods 
    for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)  # r >= 2 (exclude expiring items)
)

waste_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods
)

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods
)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + inventory_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve the model
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

data = json.loads(data_str)

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
periods = data["periods"]
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]
moq = data["constraints"]["moq"]

# Create decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - order quantity
z = {}  # z[p,t] - binary variable for MOQ
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales in period t with r periods remaining
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste in period t
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales in period t

for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        z[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"z_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Add constraints
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        # MOQ constraints
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] >= moq * z[p, t], name=f"moq_lower_{p}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1] * z[p, t], name=f"moq_upper_{p}_{t}")
        
        # Production capacity constraint
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            # Fresh inflow constraint (r = SL)
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Demand satisfaction constraint
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, SL + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Waste definition constraint
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Sales bounds constraints
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_bound_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Aging constraints (for t < periods)
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], 
                               name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Initial inventory constraints (all zero)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Set objective function
obj = gp.quicksum(
    costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            # Holding cost (on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
            holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
                costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
                for r in range(2, SL + 1)
            )
            obj += holding_cost
            
            # Waste cost
            obj += costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t]
            
            # Lost sales cost
            obj += costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve the model
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Inventory dynamics and FIFO constraints
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        # Initial period: start with zero inventory
        for r in range(1, SL + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0)
        
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            # Fresh inflow (r = SL)
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])
            
            # Aging for r = 1 to SL-1
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])
            
            # Waste calculation (r = 1)
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])
            
            # Sales cannot exceed inventory
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])
            
            # Demand fulfillment
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, SL + 1))
            location_demand = demand[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales_var[p, l, t] == location_demand)

purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(
    cost_purchasing[p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
    cost_inventory[p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
    for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)  # r >= 2 (exclude expiring items)
)

waste_cost = gp.quicksum(
    cost_waste[p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(
    cost_lost_sales[p] * lost_sales_var[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - order quantity

        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):

    for p in products:
        # Pack size constraint: Q[p,t] must be multiple of pack_size
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] == pack_size * Q[p, t].getAttr('Var'), name=f"pack_size_{p}_{t}")
        
        # Production capacity constraint
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            # Fresh inflow constraint (only for freshest inventory)
            sl = shelf_life[p]
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, sl] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, sl + 1))

            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales_qty[p, l, t] == demand_at_loc, name=f"demand_fulfill_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Sales availability constraints
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Waste definition constraint
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_def_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Aging constraints (for next period)
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, sl):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                
                # For the oldest age, inventory comes from aging of previous period's second-oldest
                # (handled by the loop above for r=1..sl-1)

            m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
total_cost = 0

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cost += costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                total_cost += costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_cost += costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_cost += costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales_qty[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

costs = data["costs"]

I = {}  # Inventory of product p at location l at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # Sales of product p from location l in period t from age bucket r

        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            # Fresh inflow constraint
            if t <= periods:
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], 
                           name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            demand_at_loc = demand[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales_var[p, l, t] == demand_at_loc, 
                       name=f"demand_fulfill_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Sales limits
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_limit_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], 
                               name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

                m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], 
                           name=f"waste_calc_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # For the last period, all remaining inventory becomes waste
            if t == periods:
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                    m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] == I[p, l, t, r], 
                               name=f"clear_inv_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
    
    # Storage capacity constraint
    for l in locations:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
total_cost = 0

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cost += costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):  # r >= 2
                total_cost += costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_cost += costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_cost += costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales_var[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

locations = data["locations"]
periods = data["periods"]
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]
pack_size = data["constraints"]["pack_size"]

# Create decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - order quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory of product p at location l at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t from inventory with r periods remaining
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste of product p at location l in period t
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales of product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 2. Aging constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t + 1, r] == I[p, l, t, r + 1] - sales[p, l, t, r + 1],
                           name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 3. Waste constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1],
                       name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r],
                           name=f"sales_limit_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l],
                       name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 6. Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_{l}_{t}")

# 7. Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"production_{p}_{t}")

# 8. Pack size constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] % pack_size == 0, name=f"pack_size_{p}_{t}")

# Set objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
    for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)  # r >= 2 as specified
)

waste_cost_total = gp.quicksum(
    costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

lost_sales_cost_total = gp.quicksum(
    costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost_total + lost_sales_cost_total
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve the model
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
periods = data["periods"]
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
pack_size = data["constraints"]["pack_size"]

costs = data["costs"]
purchasing_cost = costs["purchasing"]
inventory_cost = costs["inventory"]
waste_cost = costs["waste"]
lost_sales_cost = costs["lost_sales"]

# Create sets
T = range(1, periods + 1)

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - order quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory of product p at location l at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t from age r
lost_sales_var = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales of product p at location l in period t
waste_var = {}  # waste[p,l,t] - waste of product p at location l in period t

# Create variables
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        # Order quantity must be integer multiple of pack_size
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            lost_sales_var[p, l, t] = m.addVar(name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            waste_var[p, l, t] = m.addVar(name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            SL = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Constraints
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    
    for t in T:
        # Pack size constraint: Q[p,t] must be multiple of pack_size
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] % pack_size == 0, name=f"pack_size_{p}_{t}")
        
        # Production capacity constraint
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"production_cap_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            # Fresh inventory inflow (r = SL)
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Demand fulfillment constraint
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, SL + 1))
            demand_at_location = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales_var[p, l, t] == demand_at_location, 
                       name=f"demand_fulfillment_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Sales cannot exceed inventory
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_limit_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Waste calculation (for r=1 items not sold)
            if t > 1:  # Waste exists from period 2 onwards
                m.addConstr(waste_var[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], 
                           name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            else:
                # Period 1: no waste from previous period
                m.addConstr(waste_var[p, l, t] == 0, name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Inventory aging (for periods after the first)
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1],
                               name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                
                # For the freshest inventory next period, it comes from new orders (handled above)
                # Items that would age beyond shelf life become waste (handled by r=1 constraint)

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        cold_usage_total = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(cold_usage_total <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Initial inventory (all zero at period 1)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        SL = shelf_life[p]
        for r in range(1, SL + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"initial_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost_total = gp.quicksum(
    purchasing_cost[p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in T
)

holding_cost_total = gp.quicksum(
    inventory_cost[p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in T for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)
)

waste_cost_total = gp.quicksum(
    waste_cost[p] * waste_var[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T
)

lost_sales_cost_total = gp.quicksum(
    lost_sales_cost[p] * lost_sales_var[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T
)

total_cost = purchasing_cost_total + holding_cost_total + waste_cost_total + lost_sales_cost_total
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

3. Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1] ∀ p,l,t

                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Add constraints
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        # Production capacity constraint
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
        
        # Budget constraint (sum over all products)
        if t == 1:  # Add budget constraint once per period
            budget_expr = gp.quicksum(costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products)
            m.addConstr(budget_expr <= budget, name=f"budget_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            # Fresh inflow constraint (r = SL)
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Demand satisfaction constraint
            demand_val = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            sales_sum = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, SL + 1))
            m.addConstr(sales_sum + lost_sales_var[p, l, t] == demand_val, name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Sales availability constraints
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Waste constraint (r = 1)
            if t <= periods:  # Waste only defined for existing periods
                m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Aging constraints (for t < periods)
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        storage_expr = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(storage_expr <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_{l}_{t}")

# Set objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()

# Purchasing cost (applied to total production)
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        obj += costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t]

# Holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            obj += costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            obj += costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales_var[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve the model
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

m.Params.Seed = 0

waste_indices = lost_indices  # same indices as lost_sales
Q_indices = [(p, t) for p in products for t in periods]

# Add variables
I = m.addVars(inv_indices, name="I")
sales = m.addVars(inv_indices, name="sales")
lost_sales = m.addVars(lost_indices, name="lost_sales")
W = m.addVars(waste_indices, name="W")
Q = m.addVars(Q_indices, name="Q")

# Fresh inflow constraints
for p in products:
    sl = data['shelf_life'][p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:

    sl = data['shelf_life'][p]
    for l in locations:

            m.addConstr(total_sales <= d, name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            m.addConstr(L[p, l, t] == d - total_sales, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")

for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(data['cold_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, data['shelf_life'][p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= data['cold_capacity'][l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

for p in products:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= data['production_cap'][p][t-1], name=f"production_cap_{p}_{t}")

for t in T:
    total_spend = gp.quicksum(data['costs']['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products)
    m.addConstr(total_spend <= data['constraints']['budget_per_period'], name=f"budget_{t}")

purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(data['costs']['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in T)

holding_cost = 0
for p in products:
    SL = data['shelf_life'][p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(2, SL+1):
                holding_cost += data['costs']['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(data['costs']['lost_sales'][p] * L[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

total_obj = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Extract parameters
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
periods = data["periods"]
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]
budget_per_period = data["constraints"]["budget_per_period"]

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory of product p at location l at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # Sales of product p at location l in period t with r periods remaining
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales of product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # Waste of product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Constraints
# 1. Fresh inflow
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 2. Aging and inventory balance
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1],
                           name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 3. Waste definition
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1],
                       name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 4. Sales cannot exceed inventory
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r],
                           name=f"sales_limit_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 5. Demand satisfaction
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l],
                       name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 6. Storage capacity
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_{l}_{t}")

# 7. Budget constraint
for t in range(1, periods + 1):
    total_spend = gp.quicksum(costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products)
    m.addConstr(total_spend <= budget_per_period, name=f"budget_{t}")

# 8. Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"production_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Objective function
total_cost = 0

# Purchasing cost (applied to total production)
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cost += costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t]

# Holding cost (on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                total_cost += costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_cost += costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_cost += costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

Business narrative:
The network has one high-capacity hub distribution center that ships to several low-capacity spokes. All lateral movements must pass through the hub; spokes cannot ship directly to each other or back to the hub. Demand occurs at spokes and is local. This captures a hub-and-spoke distribution strategy where stock is pooled at the hub and then pushed out to stores.

Structure cues:
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

  (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2

- For each product, location, and period, inventory evolves based on local production (if any), inbound shipments, outbound shipments, sales (at spokes), and waste, and must remain non-negative.
- Transshipment flows from the hub are limited by the hub's available inventory and incur transshipment costs. Spokes largely rely on inbound shipments from the hub to meet local demand.
- Lead times for transshipment are effectively zero, and substitution behavior remains as encoded.
- The objective is to minimize total cost (aggregating purchasing, holding, waste, lost sales, and transshipment costs) while exploiting the centralized hub structure.

- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

- Transshipment flows from the hub are limited by the hub's available inventory and incur transshipment costs. Spokes largely rely on inbound shipments from the hub to meet local demand.
- Lead times for transshipment are effectively zero, and substitution behavior remains as encoded.

**Objective**: Minimize total cost (purchasing, holding, waste, lost sales, and transshipment costs) in a hub-and-spoke distribution network.

**Key Decisions**:
- Production quantities for each product in each period
- Transshipment flows from hub (DC1) to spokes (DC2-DC5)

**Constraints**:
- Shelf life tracking with FIFO aging
- Storage capacity at each location
- Production capacity limits
- Network flow constraints (hub-to-spoke only)
- Non-negativity and inventory balance
- Sales cannot exceed available inventory

**Key Features**:
- Inventory tracked by remaining shelf life periods
- Fresh inventory enters at maximum shelf life
- Items age each period (r decreases by 1)
- Waste occurs when items with r=1 expire unsold
- Hub acts as central distribution point

## Step 2: Mathematical Formulation

**Sets**:
- Products: P = {"SKU_Basic", "SKU_Premium", "SKU_ShortLife"}
- Locations: L = {"DC1", "DC2", "DC3", "DC4", "DC5"}
- Periods: T = {1, 2, ..., 20}
- Shelf life ages: R_p = {1, 2, ..., shelf_life[p]} for each p ∈ P

**Parameters**:
- shelf_life[p]: Maximum shelf life for product p
- demand_curve[p][t]: Total demand for product p in period t
- demand_share[l]: Fraction of demand allocated to location l
- production_cap[p][t]: Maximum production for product p in period t
- cold_capacity[l]: Storage capacity at location l
- cold_usage[p]: Storage space per unit of product p
- costs: Various cost coefficients

**Decision Variables** (CONTINUOUS, since fractional units are allowed):
- Q[p,t] ≥ 0: Production quantity of product p in period t
- I[p,l,t,r] ≥ 0: Inventory of product p at location l at start of period t with r periods remaining
- sales[p,l,t,r] ≥ 0: Sales of product p at location l in period t from age group r
- W[p,l,t] ≥ 0: Waste of product p at location l in period t
- transship[p,l,t] ≥ 0: Transshipment flow of product p from DC1 to location l in period t
- lost_sales[p,l,t] ≥ 0: Lost sales of product p at location l in period t

**Constraints**:

1. **Production capacity**: Q[p,t] ≤ production_cap[p][t-1] for all p ∈ P, t ∈ T

2. **Fresh inventory inflow**: I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l] for all p ∈ P, l ∈ L, t ∈ T

3. **Aging process**: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for all p ∈ P, l ∈ L, t ∈ T\{20}, r ∈ {1,...,shelf_life[p]-1}

4. **Waste calculation**: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1] for all p ∈ P, l ∈ L, t ∈ T

5. **Sales limits**: sales[p,l,t,r] ≤ I[p,l,t,r] for all p ∈ P, l ∈ L, t ∈ T, r ∈ R_p

6. **Demand satisfaction**: ∑_{r∈R_p} sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l] for all p ∈ P, l ∈ L, t ∈ T

7. **Storage capacity**: ∑_{p∈P} cold_usage[p] * ∑_{r∈R_p} I[p,l,t,r] ≤ cold_capacity[l] for all l ∈ L, t ∈ T

8. **Transshipment network**:

9. **Inventory balance with transshipment**: For hub (DC1): I[p,"DC1",t+1,r] accounts for production and outbound transshipments. For spokes: I[p,l,t+1,r] accounts for aging and inbound transshipments.

          + ∑_{p,l,t} costs.lost_sales[p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]

data = json.loads(data_str)

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
periods = range(1, data["periods"] + 1)
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]
trans_edges = data["network"]["trans_edges"]

# Create sets for transshipment edges
transshipment_pairs = [(src, dest) for src, dest in trans_edges]

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity
I = {}  # Inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # Sales from inventory with r periods remaining
W = {}  # Waste
transship = {}  # Transshipment flows
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales

# Create variables
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            if l != "DC1":  # Transshipment only from hub to spokes
                transship[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"transship_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            else:
                transship[p, l, t] = 0  # No transshipment to hub
            
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Constraints
# 1. Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# 2. Fresh inventory inflow (at maximum shelf life)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 3. Aging process and inventory balance
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            if t < data["periods"]:  # Not for last period
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    # Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1],
                               name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                
                # Handle transshipment for inventory balance
                if l == "DC1":  # Hub: inventory decreases by outbound transshipments
                    total_outbound = gp.quicksum(transship[p, dest, t] for dest in locations if dest != "DC1")
                    for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                        m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1] - total_outbound,
                                   name=f"hub_balance_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                else:  # Spoke: inventory increases by inbound transshipments
                    for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                        m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1] + transship[p, l, t],
                                   name=f"spoke_balance_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 4. Waste calculation
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1],
                       name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 5. Sales limits
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r],
                           name=f"sales_limit_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 6. Demand satisfaction
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l],
                       name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 7. Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_storage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) 
                        for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_storage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# 8. Transshipment constraints - only allowed on defined edges
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            if l == "DC1":
                # Hub cannot receive transshipments
                m.addConstr(transship[p, l, t] == 0, name=f"no_transship_to_hub_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            else:
                # Transshipment only allowed if edge exists
                if ("DC1", l) not in transshipment_pairs:
                    m.addConstr(transship[p, l, t] == 0, name=f"no_transship_edge_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in periods)
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r]) 
                  for p in products for l in locations for t in periods for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)
transship_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["transshipment"] * transship[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost + transship_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

    for t in periods:

            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_capacity_{l}_{t}")

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                if r == shelf_life[p]:
                    I_fresh_val = Q[p, t] * demand_share[l]
                else:
                    if t == 1:
                        I_fresh_val = 0
                    else:
                        I_fresh_val = I[p, l, t - 1, r + 1] - sales[p, l, t - 1, r + 1]
                if l == "DC1":
                    net_trans = -gp.quicksum(T[p, l_prime, t, r] for l_prime in spokes)
                else:
                    net_trans = T[p, l, t, r]
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, r] == I_fresh_val + net_trans, name=f"inventory_balance_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            if r == shelf_life[p]:
                I_fresh_val_hub = Q[p, t] * demand_share["DC1"]
            else:
                if t == 1:
                    I_fresh_val_hub = 0
                else:
                    I_fresh_val_hub = I[p, "DC1", t - 1, r + 1] - sales[p, "DC1", t - 1, r + 1]
            m.addConstr(
                gp.quicksum(T[p, l, t, r] for l in spokes) <= I_fresh_val_hub,
                name=f"transshipment_cap_{p}_{t}_{r}"
            )

purchasing_cost = costs["purchasing"]
inventory_cost = costs["inventory"]
waste_cost = costs["waste"]
lost_sales_cost = costs["lost_sales"]
transshipment_cost = costs["transshipment"]

obj = gp.quicksum(purchasing_cost[p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in periods)
obj += gp.quicksum(
    inventory_cost[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1))
    for p in products for l in locations for t in periods

obj += gp.quicksum(lost_sales_cost[p] * L[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)
obj += gp.quicksum(transshipment_cost * T[p, l, t, r] for p in products for l in spokes for t in periods for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(f"status: {m.status}")
if m.status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.objVal}")

[BUSINESS DESCRIPTION]
Business narrative:
The network has one high-capacity hub distribution center that ships to several low-capacity spokes. All lateral movements must pass through the hub; spokes cannot ship directly to each other or back to the hub. Demand occurs at spokes and is local. This captures a hub-and-spoke distribution strategy where stock is pooled at the hub and then pushed out to stores.

Structure cues:
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

  (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
      - Charge on END-of-period inventory (after sales), exclude expiring items (r=1)
- Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]. DC1 (hub) has capacity 50000, while other locations (spokes) have capacity 500 each.
- The transshipment network consists only of directed edges from DC1 (hub) to each spoke [DC2, DC3, DC4, DC5]. Inventory can move from the hub to the spokes but not directly between spokes and not from spokes back to the hub.
- For each product, location, and period, inventory evolves based on local production (if any), inbound shipments, outbound shipments, sales (at spokes), and waste, and must remain non-negative.
- Transshipment flows from the hub are limited by the hub's available inventory and incur transshipment costs. Spokes largely rely on inbound shipments from the hub to meet local demand.
- Lead times for transshipment are effectively zero, and substitution behavior remains as encoded.
- The objective is to minimize total cost (aggregating purchasing, holding, waste, lost sales, and transshipment costs) while exploiting the centralized hub structure.

**Step 1: Problem Understanding**

This is a multi-period inventory optimization problem for a hub-and-spoke distribution network with perishable products. The key features:
- Products have shelf life tracked by remaining periods (FIFO)
- Hub (DC1) receives production and distributes to spokes (DC2-DC5)
- No direct spoke-to-spoke or spoke-to-hub shipments
- Demand occurs only at spokes
- Objective: Minimize total costs (production, holding, waste, lost sales, transshipment)

**Step 2: Mathematical Formulation**

**Sets:**
- P: Products {SKU_Basic, SKU_Premium, SKU_ShortLife}
- L: Locations {DC1, DC2, DC3, DC4, DC5}
- T: Periods {1,...,20}
- R[p]: Remaining life periods for product p {1,...,shelf_life[p]}

**Parameters:**
- shelf_life[p], demand_curve[p,t], demand_share[l], cold_capacity[l]
- cold_usage[p], production_cap[p,t], costs (purchasing, inventory, waste, lost_sales, transshipment)

**Decision Variables (All CONTINUOUS, non-negative):**
- Q[p,t]: Production quantity
- I[p,l,t,r]: Inventory at start of period t with remaining life r
- sales[p,l,t,r]: Sales from inventory with remaining life r
- W[p,l,t]: Waste quantity
- lost_sales[p,l,t]: Lost sales quantity
- transship[p,l,t]: Transshipment from DC1 to spoke l

**Constraints:**
1. **Production capacity:** Q[p,t] ≤ production_cap[p][t-1]
2. **Fresh inflow:** I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] = Q[p,t] × demand_share[l]
3. **Aging:** I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
4. **Waste:** W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
5. **Sales bounds:** sales[p,l,t,r] ≤ I[p,l,t,r]
6. **Demand satisfaction:** Σ_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand[p,l,t] for spokes
7. **Transshipment limits:** transship[p,l,t] ≤ available hub inventory
8. **Storage capacity:** Σ_p cold_usage[p] × Σ_r I[p,l,t,r] ≤ cold_capacity[l]

**Objective:** Minimize total cost = 
- Production cost: Σ_p,t costs.purchasing[p] × Q[p,t]
- Holding cost: Σ_p,l,t costs.inventory[p] × Σ_{r≥2} (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])
- Waste cost: Σ_p,l,t costs.waste[p] × W[p,l,t]
- Lost sales cost: Σ_p,l,t costs.lost_sales[p] × lost_sales[p,l,t]
- Transshipment cost: Σ_p,l,t costs.transshipment × transship[p,l,t]

# Create model
m = gp.Model("retail_f7_hub_and_spoke")
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Sets
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
spokes = [l for l in locations if l != "DC1"]
periods = list(range(data["periods"]))
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]

# Parameters
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
costs = data["costs"]

# Decision variables
Q = m.addVars(products, periods, name="Q")
I = m.addVars(products, locations, periods, 
             [(r+1) for p in products for r in range(shelf_life[p])], 
             name="I")
sales = m.addVars(products, locations, periods, 
                 [(r+1) for p in products for r in range(shelf_life[p])], 
                 name="sales")
W = m.addVars(products, locations, periods, name="W")
lost_sales = m.addVars(products, locations, periods, name="lost_sales")
transship = m.addVars(products, spokes, periods, name="transship")

# Constraints
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for t in periods:
        # Production capacity
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t])
        
        for l in locations:
            # Fresh inflow (r = shelf_life)
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, sl] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])
            
            # Aging and waste constraints
            if t < periods[-1]:
                for r in range(1, sl):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])
            
            # Waste calculation
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])
            
            # Sales bounds
            for r in range(1, sl+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])
            
            # Demand satisfaction (spokes only)
            if l != "DC1":
                demand = demand_curve[p][t] * demand_share[l]
                m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, sl+1)) + 
                           lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand)
            else:
                # No sales at hub
                for r in range(1, sl+1):
                    m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] == 0)
        
        # Transshipment constraints (from hub to spokes)
        for l in spokes:
            # Transshipment limited by hub inventory
            hub_inventory = gp.quicksum(I[p, "DC1", t, r] for r in range(1, sl+1))
            m.addConstr(transship[p, l, t] <= hub_inventory)
            
            # Inventory balance for transshipment
            if t < periods[-1]:
                for r in range(1, sl):
                    # Hub loses transshipped inventory
                    m.addConstr(I[p, "DC1", t+1, r] <= I[p, "DC1", t, r+1] - 
                               sales[p, "DC1", t, r+1] - transship[p, l, t])
                    # Spoke gains transshipped inventory
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] >= I[p, l, t, r+1] - 
                               sales[p, l, t, r+1] + transship[p, l, t])

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_inv = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * 
                               gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
                               for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inv <= cold_capacity[l])

# Objective function
production_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] 
                             for p in products for t in periods)
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["inventory"][p] * 
                          (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
                          for p in products for l in locations 
                          for t in periods for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t] 
                        for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] 
                             for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)
transship_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["transshipment"] * transship[p, l, t] 
                            for p in products for l in spokes for t in periods)

m.setObjective(production_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + 
              lost_sales_cost + transship_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

## Problem
[SCENARIO]
Family: F7 (Network and Multi Echelon)
Archetype: retail_f7_hub_and_spoke
Scenario ID: retail_f7_hub_and_spoke_v4

[BUSINESS DESCRIPTION]
Business narrative:
The network has one high-capacity hub distribution center that ships to several low-capacity spokes. All lateral movements must pass through the hub; spokes cannot ship directly to each other or back to the hub. Demand occurs at spokes and is local. This captures a hub-and-spoke distribution strategy where stock is pooled at the hub and then pushed out to stores.

Structure cues:
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

  (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
      - Charge on END-of-period inventory (after sales), exclude expiring items (r=1)
- Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]. DC1 (hub) has capacity 50000, while other locations (spokes) have capacity 500 each.
- The transshipment network consists only of directed edges from DC1 (hub) to each spoke [DC2, DC3, DC4, DC5]. Inventory can move from the hub to the spokes but not directly between spokes and not from spokes back to the hub.
- For each product, location, and period, inventory evolves based on local production (if any), inbound shipments, outbound shipments, sales (at spokes), and waste, and must remain non-negative.
- Transshipment flows from the hub are limited by the hub's available inventory and incur transshipment costs. Spokes largely rely on inbound shipments from the hub to meet local demand.
- Lead times for transshipment are effectively zero, and substitution behavior remains as encoded.
- The objective is to minimize total cost (aggregating purchasing, holding, waste, lost sales, and transshipment costs) while exploiting the centralized hub structure.

Structure cues:
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

  (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
      - Charge on END-of-period inventory (after sales), exclude expiring items (r=1)

- Transshipment flows from the hub are limited by the hub's available inventory and incur transshipment costs. Spokes largely rely on inbound shipments from the hub to meet local demand.
- Lead times for transshipment are effectively zero, and substitution behavior remains as encoded.

  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]

        for r in range(1, SL):  # r from 1 to SL-1
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Fresh inflow constraints
for p in products:
    L_p = lead_time[p]
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            if t > L_p:
                # Q[p, t - L_p] is defined since t - L_p >= 1
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == demand_share[l] * Q[p, t - L_p], name=f"inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            else:
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == 0, name=f"no_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Aging constraints
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):  # t from 1 to 19
            for r in range(1, SL):  # r from 1 to SL-1
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t + 1, r] == I[p, l, t, r + 1] - sales[p, l, t, r + 1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Waste constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Sales availability constraints
for p, l, t, r in sales_keys:
    m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            D_plt = demand_curve[p][t - 1] * demand_share[l]
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == D_plt, name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_inv = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_inv <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function: minimize total cost
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in T
)

holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in T for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)
)

waste_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T
)

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T
)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Data is pre-defined, access directly
periods = list(range(1, data["periods"] + 1))
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]

# Create indices for variables
# Q variables: (p, t) for each product and period
Q_indices = [(p, t) for p in products for t in periods]

# I and sales variables: (p, l, t, r) for each product, location, period, and remaining life r from 1 to shelf_life[p]
inventory_indices = []
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                inventory_indices.append((p, l, t, r))

# W and lost_sales variables: (p, l, t) for each product, location, period
W_indices = [(p, l, t) for p in products for l in locations for t in periods]

# Add variables
Q = m.addVars(Q_indices, name="Q")
I = m.addVars(inventory_indices, name="I")
sales = m.addVars(inventory_indices, name="sales")
W = m.addVars(W_indices, name="W")
lost_sales_var = m.addVars(W_indices, name="lost_sales")

# Constraints
# 1. Production capacity constraint
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        cap = production_cap[p][t - 1]  # t-1 for zero-indexed list
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= cap, name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# 2. Fresh inflow constraint
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        share = demand_share[l]
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, sl] == Q[p, t] * share, name=f"inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 3. Aging constraint
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            if t < periods[-1]:  # t from 1 to 19 for periods=20
                for r in range(1, sl):  # r from 1 to SL-1
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t + 1, r] == I[p, l, t, r + 1] - sales[p, l, t, r + 1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 4. Waste constraint
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 5. Sales availability constraint
for (p, l, t, r) in inventory_indices:
    m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 6. Demand constraint
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        share = demand_share[l]
        for t in periods:
            demand_val = demand_curve[p][t - 1] * share  # t-1 for zero-indexed list
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales_var[p, l, t] == demand_val, name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 7. Storage capacity constraint
for l in locations:
    cap = cold_capacity[l]
    for t in periods:
        total_inv = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_inv <= cap, name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# 8. Initial conditions for t=1: set I[p,l,1,r] = 0 for r < shelf_life[p]
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, sl):  # r from 1 to SL-1
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"init_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in periods
)
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in periods
    for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)  # r >= 2
)
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods
)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales_var[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods
)
total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

data = json.loads(data_str)

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
periods = data["periods"]
products = data["products"]
locations = data["locations"]
shelf_life = data["shelf_life"]
lead_time = data["lead_time"]
cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
production_cap = data["production_cap"]
demand_curve = data["demand_curve"]
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]

# Create decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity
I = {}  # Inventory at start of period
sales = {}  # Sales
waste = {}  # Waste
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales

# Production variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(lb=0, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")

# Inventory, sales, waste, and lost sales variables
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            # Lost sales
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(lb=0, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Waste
            waste[p, l, t] = m.addVar(lb=0, name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Inventory and sales by remaining life
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(lb=0, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(lb=0, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Constraints

# 1. Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# 2. Fresh inventory inflow constraints (with lead time)
for p in products:
    lt = lead_time[p]
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            if t > lt:
                # Production from t-lt periods ago arrives now
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, sl] == Q[p, t - lt] * demand_share[l], 
                           name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            else:
                # No production before lead time has elapsed
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, sl] == 0, name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 3. Inventory aging constraints
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, sl):
                # Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1],
                           name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 4. Waste calculation constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(waste[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1],
                       name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 5. Sales cannot exceed inventory constraints
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r],
                           name=f"sales_limit_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 6. Demand fulfillment constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l],
                       name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 7. Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
    for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)  # r >= 2 (exclude expiring items)
)

waste_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["waste"][p] * waste[p, l, t]
    for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]
    for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve the model
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

        for t in T:

            lost_sales_qty[p, l, t] = m.addVar(lb=0, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(lb=0, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Constraints
# 1. Production capacity
for p in products:

        for r in range(1, sl):  # r from 1 to sl-1

# 4. Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for t in T, r in 1 to sl-1
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:  # t from 1 to 20, so t+1 from 2 to 21
            for r in range(1, sl):  # r from 1 to sl-1
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t + 1, r] == I[p, l, t, r + 1] - sales[p, l, t, r + 1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# 5. Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1] for t in T
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# 6. Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r] for all t in T, r
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales_qty[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T)
total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost

m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
