cold_capacity = data["cold_capacity"]
cold_usage = data["cold_usage"]
costs = data["costs"]
waste_limit_pct = data["constraints"]["waste_limit_pct"]

# Create sets
T = range(1, periods + 1)

# Calculate total demand for waste constraint
total_demand = 0
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            total_demand += demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity
I = {}  # Inventory at start of period
sales = {}  # Sales
W = {}  # Waste
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales
substitution_sales = {}  # Substitution sales (Basic for Premium)

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Initialize inventory for all remaining shelf life values
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Substitution variables
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        substitution_sales["SKU_Basic", "SKU_Premium", l, t] = m.addVar(
            vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_Basic_Premium_{l}_{t}"
        )

# Constraints

# 1. Fresh inflow constraint
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(
                I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l],
                name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}"
            )

# 2. Aging constraint
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):  # t from 1 to periods-1
            for r in range(1, SL):  # r from 1 to SL-1
                m.addConstr(
                    I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1],
                    name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}"
                )

# 3. Waste definition
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(
                W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1],
                name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}"
            )

# 4. Sales bounds
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(
                    sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r],
                    name=f"sales_bound_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}"
                )

# 5. Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            demand_at_location = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            
            if p == "SKU_Premium":
                # Premium demand can be satisfied by Premium sales or Basic substitution
                m.addConstr(
                    gp.quicksum(sales["SKU_Premium", l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life["SKU_Premium"] + 1)) +
                    substitution_sales["SKU_Basic", "SKU_Premium", l, t] +
                    lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_at_location,
                    name=f"demand_premium_{l}_{t}"
                )
            else:
                # Regular demand satisfaction
                m.addConstr(
                    gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) +
                    lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_at_location,
                    name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}"
                )

# Substitution constraint: Basic substitution for Premium cannot exceed available Basic inventory
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(
            substitution_sales["SKU_Basic", "SKU_Premium", l, t] <= 
            gp.quicksum(sales["SKU_Basic", l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life["SKU_Basic"] + 1)),
            name=f"substitution_limit_{l}_{t}"
        )

# 6. Storage capacity constraint
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(
            gp.quicksum(
                cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
                for p in products
            ) <= cold_capacity[l],
            name=f"storage_capacity_{l}_{t}"
        )

# 7. Production capacity constraint
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(
            Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1],
            name=f"production_cap_{p}_{t}"
        )

# 8. Waste limit constraint
total_waste = gp.quicksum(W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T)
m.addConstr(
    total_waste <= waste_limit_pct * total_demand,
    name="waste_limit"
)

# Initial inventory (assume zero)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"initial_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["purchasing"][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in T)
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs["inventory"][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in T for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)
)
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["waste"][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in T)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
